description: Create a dataset in your Ultralytics workspace. Defaults to private visibility (the platform defaults to public when visibility is omitted).

classNames.description: Initial class names for the dataset.

dataset.description: URL slug for the new dataset (distinct from the display name given by name).

owner.description: Workspace owner; defaults to the account owner.

task.description: Dataset task. Server-validated; for example detect, segment, or classify.

name: datasets_create
